hooks.name: Lint on Save
hooks.description: Runs the project linter after the agent modifies a source file. REPLACE the command with your linter before enabling.

action.command: echo 'lint-on-save is not configured yet. Edit .kiro/hooks/lint-on-save.json and replace this command with your linter, for example: ruff check --fix src/ | npx eslint --fix src/ | dotnet format' >&2; exit 1
